mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior quarter's trend indicates stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > 0.5% above prior quarter's trend
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered quarters (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressure, compresses profit margins, and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% and continues declining for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior quarter's trend indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO quarterly growth < -0.5% below prior quarter's trend
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered quarters (t-test p > 0.10).
